title: Whale with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='eyeGlow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#9fe8ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3aa8e0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- water spout -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='18' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#8fe3ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='24' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#7ad4f5'/>
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='23' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#7ad4f5'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='57' rx='38' ry='26' fill='#3f7fc4'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='70' rx='28' ry='11' fill='#8fc6ee'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M84 50 Q96 38 94 50 Q96 62 84 56 Z' fill='#2f66a8'/>
  <path d='M84 50 Q92 49 86 53 Z' fill='#6fb3e6'/>
  <!-- top shading -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='40' rx='30' ry='9' fill='#5a9ad8'/>
  <!-- fin -->
  <path d='M56 74 Q62 86 50 84 Q52 78 50 72 Z' fill='#2f66a8'/>
  <!-- eye sparkles -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='50' r='7' fill='url(#eyeGlow)'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='50' r='3' fill='#103a5c'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='48' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='52' r='0.9' fill='#e8f9ff'/>
  <!-- second eye -->
  <circle cx='52' cy='50' r='7' fill='url(#eyeGlow)'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='50' r='3' fill='#103a5c'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='52' r='0.9' fill='#e8f9ff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M38 62 Q44 68 52 62' stroke='#d8f3ff' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='60' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff9ec4' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='60' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff9ec4' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- little bubbles -->
  <circle cx='12' cy='46' r='2.5' fill='#a9e6ff'/>
  <circle cx='8' cy='36' r='1.8' fill='#a9e6ff'/>
  <circle cx='15' cy='30' r='1.2' fill='#a9e6ff'/>
</svg>
